name: cli-contextual-command-availability
instr:
Add audience selection through context that consistently governs invocation, help, documentation, and completion. Applications that do not use availability must remain unchanged.

The `github.com/urfave/cli/v3` package must export `AvailabilityMode`, `AvailabilityRule`, `AvailabilityResult`, `EvaluateAvailability`, `WithAudience`, `AudienceFromContext`, `AvailabilityError`, `HelpAvailabilityMode`, and `Command.SetHelpAvailabilityMode`. An `Availability AvailabilityRule` declaration supports unrestricted, allow-list, and deny-list policy on commands and flags. Direct evaluation returns a stable snapshot of the supplied audience, decision, and matched mode. Context selection is immutable and nestable; an absent audience preserves unrestricted behavior.

Reject every known unavailable command or flag with `AvailabilityError` before destinations, validators, hooks, or actions run. Keep existing handling of unknown names. Persistent flags require descendant visibility and audience permission. Generated help, version, and completion nodes inherit applicable graph restrictions.

Filtered help, runtime completion, and parsing must agree for the selected audience. Descriptive help may annotate unavailable entries, but permanently hidden entries never appear.
